**Goal:** Confirm the locked PRD meets the PRD quality bar: cohesive journeys, requirements, acceptance criteria, metrics, and scope.

**Scope:** Read the locked `<Subject> - PRD` and the SpecX spec `Work Intake & Artifact Selection Guide`. Record gaps. Do not edit the document or application code. Do not commit, push, open a pull request, publish, or deploy.

**Verification / Definition of Done:** Every journey has a user need, observable steps, and pass/fail acceptance criteria. Every requirement has intent and testable acceptance criteria. Goals are measurable, non-goals are explicit, and scope is cohesive. Gaps are listed, or the PRD is reported ready.

**Instructions:**

- Resolve the SpecX spec `Work Intake & Artifact Selection Guide` by exact title. If it cannot be found, stop and report that exact missing title.
- Reread the document titled `<Subject> - PRD` in full. If that title is unavailable, repeat resolution rather than guessing.
- Check the PRD quality bar: problem, audience, and 1–3 measurable goals; explicit non-goals that are not deferred stretch items; journeys with need, steps, and acceptance criteria; requirements with intent and testable acceptance criteria; assumptions and open questions labeled as such.
- Confirm journeys, requirements, acceptance criteria, and metrics cohere — they describe one product outcome, not unrelated wishlists. Reject invented personas, metrics, or implementation detail.
- Report the document title and version, what passed, and any remaining gaps. Do not mark the PRD ready while a quality-bar item fails.
